pathwayCovered: Quebec-selected skilled workers - FEDERAL (IRCC) stage only
CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_WARNING: Bu dosya Kanada'nin diger pathway dosyalarindan (Express Entry, PNP, AIP, RCIP/FCIP) koklu sekilde farkli bir uyari tasiyor: BU SADECE IKI ASAMALI SURECIN IKINCI (federal/IRCC) ASAMASI. Quebec'in KENDI secim sureci (Certificat de selection du Quebec - CSQ alma; kendi puan tablosu - CRS degil; kendi portali - Arrima; muhtemelen kendi ucretleri ve isleme suresi) BU DOSYADA YOK ve henuz hic arastirilmadi/JSON'a dokulmedi. Bu sayfayi 'Quebec'e goc etmenin tam sureci' gibi sunmak YANLIS olur - kullanici once Quebec'ten CSQ almak zorunda, bu federal 11 ay/$1,590 asamasi CSQ alindiktan SONRA basliyor. Quebec'in kendi tarafi (QSWP/PSTQ, Arrima) tamamen ayri, henuz baslanmamis bir arastirma/entegrasyon isi.

stage1_quebec.name: Quebec Selection (Certificat de selection du Quebec - CSQ)
stage1_quebec.authority: Ministere de l'Immigration, de la Francisation et de l'Integration (MIFI), Government of Quebec
stage1_quebec.status: NOT YET DOCUMENTED - separate research task required (own points grid, own portal Arrima, own fees/processing time, distinct from federal CRS)
knownFacts: As of 2018, MIFI no longer renews CSQs
A CSQ remains valid for federal application purposes until IRCC makes a decision, even if it has technically expired

stage2_federal_this_document.name: Federal Permanent Residence Application (IRCC)
stage2_federal_this_document.prerequisite: Must already hold a valid CSQ from Quebec before applying
stage2_federal_this_document.processingTime: 11 months (IRCC processing only - excludes Quebec's CSQ processing time entirely)

eligibility: Hold a Quebec Selection Certificate (CSQ) from the Government of Quebec
Submit a complete permanent residence application, including police certificates

applicationProcess.portal: Permanent residence online application portal (PR Portal)
applicationProcess.quebecContactNote: To apply to Quebec for a CSQ, contact the MIFI office that processes applications from the applicant's country - this contact/process is NOT detailed in this document.

downloadAndUpload_noSignatureNeeded.name: Economic Classes - Declaration of Intent to Reside in Quebec
downloadAndUpload_noSignatureNeeded.note: Distinguishing form for this pathway - explicit declaration of intent to live in Quebec specifically

conditionalForms_handSigned.name: Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada

representativeForms.name: Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual

documentsRequired.photos: One photo per person on the application, both sides scanned per portal instructions

canDo: give advice and help with application for a fee
communicate with IRCC via their own account
cannotDo: open a portal account on applicant's behalf
representativeRules.legalSignatureRule: Applicant must personally type their own name (exactly as shown on passport) after reading the declaration - legal definition of 'signed' under Canadian immigration law.

fees.note: These are FEDERAL fees only - does not include whatever Quebec charges for CSQ processing (not documented here).

biometrics.note: Required for every PR application, even if previously given and still valid

medicalExam.appliesTo: applicant + all family members, even non-accompanying

policeCertificates.rule: Must provide ADDITIONAL police certificates IF ASKED during processing
policeCertificates.differenceFromOtherPathways: Phrased conditionally ('if asked') rather than the upfront blanket rule seen in PNP/RCIP/FCIP - worth re-verifying directly with IRCC source if this is a genuine procedural difference or just a phrasing variation.

afterApply.misrepresentationConsequence: Refusal, inadmissibility finding, and/or 5-year bar from applying to come to Canada for any reason
approvalOutcome: permanent resident visa (if applicant's country requires one)

missingDataFlags: Quebec's own CSQ selection criteria / points grid (QSWP or its 2025 successor PSTQ)
French-language requirement specifics for Quebec selection itself (distinct from any federal language test)
